method: Direct interval iteration as in perturbation-tiles.v1.json; for pixels bounded through maxIterations, the V0 verifier decision (VerifierModel.lean `reference`) for every proposed period 1..maxPeriod at cycle start z_m, m = maxIterations - maxPeriod, with every reached comparison certified on interval frames.
codes:
A

accepted with period p; N no closure; C closure ambiguous; D divisor ambiguous; X not attracting; U a reached comparison is not certified
thresholds: exact products of the binary64 constants TAU_CLOSURE_SCALED, tauExclude and (1 - attractMargin) from src/domain/verifier.ts with s = max(1, |Re z_m|, |Im z_m|)
